title: The platform at rest: cluster, node pools, sandbox runtime, verifiers and judges
purpose: Check that the platform is what section 2 says before testing behaviour: a standard EKS cluster with a system pool, a GPU pool and a gVisor sandbox pool; one Deployment per pinned verifier version; two judges of different families; the datasets; an empty registry.

checks.description: the cluster is ACTIVE on Kubernetes 1.37, standard EKS (Auto Mode off)
checks.because: Terraform creates a plain cluster with managed node groups and no compute configuration.

checks.description: three node groups: 2 system, 3 GPU, 1 gVisor sandbox node with its own launch template
checks.because: The sandbox group's launch template installs gVisor at a pinned release and adds the runsc runtime to containerd.

checks.description: the gvisor RuntimeClass maps to the runsc handler and the sandbox nodes
checks.because: Pods that name the class are scheduled onto the sandbox node and started by gVisor.

checks.description: one Deployment per pinned verifier version, nine in all, each with two ready replicas
checks.because: The platform layer creates one Deployment and one Service per name@version.

checks.description: two judges of different model families serve under the name 'judge', each pinned to a commit
checks.because: vLLM serves each pinned model on its own GPU.

checks.description: eight datasets are published with their hashes, and the registry is empty
checks.because: A fresh build: no verifier has been measured yet.
